title: rosa alpina subvar. intercalaris
intro: Rosa alpina subvar. intercalaris, commonly known as alpine rose, is a rare and unique species of rose plant that thrives in high-altitude regions. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rosa alpina subvar. intercalaris are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in soothing digestive issues and alleviating stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
